FROM docker.example.test/library/alpine:3.20@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa AS certs
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates=20250911-r0

FROM registry.example.test/library/golang:1.27-alpine@sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb AS base
WORKDIR /src

FROM base AS ci
RUN apk add --no-cache curl=8.14.1-r1

FROM base AS builder
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/service .

FROM registry.example.test/library/alpine:3.20@sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
COPY --from=builder /out/service /service
ENTRYPOINT ["/service"]
